body: Security, Nit: this is accurate for `ai-review.yml`, but "closed" reads as if the whole class of risk is gone. Two other workflows still run on `pull_request`, from the PR's own merge commit, and hold secrets: `private-review.yml` (`NEARAI_API_KEY`) and `operator-approval.yml` (`ORG_TOKEN`, the org Members: read token). A same-repo push that edits either workflow could still read that secret before anyone reviews it. Agent tokens can't edit workflows, but a person with write can. Consider adding "for ai-review.yml; private-review.yml and operator-approval.yml still run on `pull_request`", or recording those two as accepted risks.
